about.title: About Me
about.subtitle: Passionate about creating exceptional digital experiences
about.para1: I'm a Front-End Engineer with 4+ years of production experience building complex, data-intensive web applications. I hold an M.Sc. in Computer Engineering from Iran University of Science and Technology and am a member of the National Elite Foundation.
about.para2: I specialize in data-governance, data-catalog and ETL interfaces. I'm an upstream contributor to Apache Superset and have built custom features on OpenMetadata, including an ETL pipeline editor and full Persian (RTL) localization. I ship accessible, performant interfaces with React, TypeScript and modern state management.
about.para3: I work well in agile, distributed teams and enjoy owning features end to end: architecting component libraries, optimizing performance (code-splitting, lazy loading, memoization) and leading i18n/RTL work. I'm open to remote full-time or contract roles and work in UTC+3:30, overlapping with European business hours.

skills.title: Skills
skills.subtitle: Technologies and tools I work with

items.title: OpenMetadata
items.description: Built custom features on a fork of this open-source data catalog and governance platform: an ETL pipeline editor with live YAML preview, i18n schema-translation tooling and full Persian (RTL) localization, plus upstream fixes.

items.title: Apache Superset
items.description: Upstream contributor to the leading open-source BI platform. Fixed a long-standing Safari bug where chart and dashboard image exports came out blank (PR #44529), plus UI consistency fixes in Explore.

items.title: Enterprise Data Catalog UI
items.description: Built a searchable Data Catalog interface (Databricks-inspired) for discovering, tagging and governing enterprise datasets. Proprietary product at Adin, so no public demo.

items.title: Large-File Upload Module
items.description: Architected a resumable multi-GB upload module with Uppy.js and the TUS protocol: pause/resume, automatic retry, and Excel, JSON, TSV and CSV support. Proprietary product at Adin, so no public demo.

items.title: Front-End Engineer
items.description: Owned end-to-end delivery of the Add Pipeline page for orchestrating ETL ingestion. Architected a resumable large-file upload module (Uppy.js + TUS) for reliable multi-GB transfers. Built Data Catalog and Mapping Table/Column UIs (Databricks-inspired), and a Role Management module with dynamic, fine-grained access control. Led full Persian (RTL) localization with i18next and improved load time with code-splitting, lazy loading and memoization.

items.title: Front-End Developer (Graduate Internship)
items.description: Contributed to production-grade telecom dashboards using React, Redux Saga, and Material UI within a large enterprise codebase. Implemented responsive UI components with Sass/CSS following design-system guidelines. Integrated Webpack build pipelines and Nginx-based deployment via Docker.

items.name: Hossein Eivazy
items.role: Data Team Lead at میلی | Milli
items.content:
Working with Hadi was a genuinely great experience. He has strong front-end expertise and approaches his work with consistency, dedication, and attention to detail. For Hadi, it's never just about getting the job done—he always aims to deliver the best possible result. That makes him someone you can truly rely on.

Beyond his technical skills, Hadi is friendly, professional, and simply a pleasure to work with. Of course, our time together wasn't all about work—our ongoing rivalry over darts was an essential part of our workdays, although we still haven't agreed on who the better player was!

I'm really glad I had the opportunity to work with Hadi, and I'm confident he would be a valuable addition to any team.

items.name: Mehdi Alemi
items.role: AI Engineer | Java Backend Developer | Technical Manager | Project Manager
items.content: I had the pleasure of collaborating with Hadi at Adin, and I was consistently impressed by his skills as a front-end developer. Hadi brings a perfect blend of technical expertise and creativity, demonstrating a strong proficiency in JavaScript and React. He played a pivotal role in OpenMetadata platform development. Beyond technical abilities, Hadi is a fantastic communicator and team player, always ready to lend support and share knowledge with colleagues. I wholeheartedly recommend Hadi for any front-end development position—he would be a valuable asset to any team.
